retrievalProfile.description: A soft-focus studio portrait of a male subject against a vibrant magenta-to-purple gradient with a mix of chrome-effect and handwritten typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium-close-up portrait of a man with a mustache, leaning forward with hands visible, set against a seamless paper background with a warm magenta-pink gradient. The lighting is soft and diffused, creating a slight glow around the subject. The upper right corner features a three-tiered typographic lockup combining sans-serif, stylized chrome, and casual script.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered with a slight lean toward the camera
Typography anchored in the top right quadrant
Color harmony between the warm skin tones and the magenta background
Contrast between the dark clothing and the vibrant backdrop

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the lower two-thirds of the frame, centered horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the metallic watch/ring provide high-contrast focal points.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's face, move down to the hands and jewelry, then up to the typographic lockup in the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space in the upper left and right corners to accommodate text and create a studio feel.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Gold and Silver (jewelry and chrome text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background with low-key, moody values in the subject.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid bright primary blues or greens
Stick to warm pinks, purples, and rich blacks

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric sans-serif, heavy italic display, and casual cursive
letterConstructionRules: Top line: Small, wide-tracked geometric sans-serif
Middle line: Thick, italicized letters with a horizontal 'speed line' or chrome extrusion effect
Bottom line: Fluid, connected script with a hand-drawn feel
characterSpecificRedesigns: The middle logo-like text features a heavy outline and internal horizontal striations to mimic chrome reflections.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between rigid geometric sans and fluid, expressive script.

preserve: The chrome effect on the middle line

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric sans-serif metadata style

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus studio portrait of a man with a mustache in a black shirt, leaning on his arms, against a magenta and purple gradient background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a three-line text block in the top right: top line in small white sans-serif, middle line in large chrome-effect italicized display font, bottom line in white script.

verificationChecks: Is the background a smooth magenta gradient?
Is the subject's lighting soft and diffused?
Does the typography follow the three-tier hierarchy?
Is the middle text line metallic or chrome-styled?

mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or brand logos
postGenerationChecks: Check for soft focus effect on the subject
Ensure the chrome text has a 3D or reflective quality
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Magenta Gradient + Soft Focus + [Chrome Display Font] + [Script Font] = 80s Soul Aesthetic
